test_title: PYST 36: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E, and F are seated in a row facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. Only two people sit between B and C. F sits fourth to the right of B. E is an immediate neighbour of A and B. What is the position of D?

options.text: Third to the left of A
Third to the right of E
Third to the left of E
Third to the right of A

solution:
According to the given information;

Only two people sit to the right of C-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42f517c93c83fc15bc2910e803d1242cae7e1bf116b67aebc86a0b58c6cb8b9f.png] 

Only two people sit between B and C-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca4df12f5ee995fbed53c781bf6ef92191df19f6d93ad72c050f0e11feeae259.png] 

F sits fourth to the right of B-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a92c8aa092d07bec9caed91cd0646c3fe7fa865f46e0a0f7b58ebabe446fd3a.png] 

E is an immediate neighbour of A and B-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/556c94657abf40935380e5f534c372b0127e6d05032f5592794f09d981e10dde.png] 

According to the final seating arrangement, D sits third to the right of A.

Hence, **option (4) **is the correct answer.
